text.tspan: Air quality: where each measure comes from
Per city: PM2.5 (sensor) · visibility (embodied) · searches (action) · news (media). Each panel has its own scale; ★ = city hall.

Sources: OpenAQ sensor metadata + Gina's city boundaries (OpenAQ Step 2) · IEM ASOS station metadata · TIGER/Line 2025 Places · Nielsen DMA outlines, community GeoJSON (simzou/nielsen-dma), approximate · Natural Earth 1:50m states · Media Cloud collections.
